title: analytics: $contains on a single-value media field answers three different ways across the data door, the dataset native and ObjectQL faces and the draft preview
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As5bdhV5T4N9vpjmZzH

## Finding

`$contains` on a single-value media field (`image` / `file`) stored as a JSON string gets three different answers on four faces, all `200`:

Measured at PR #36771's head `fe18f109` on the #36190 fixture (stored `pic` values are the JSON strings `"file_1"` and `"file_2"`; two rows null), through the production composition each door calls (engine find behind `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query`; `queryDataset` behind `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query`):

| Filter | Data door | Dataset native face | Dataset ObjectQL face | Draft preview |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `pic {$contains: 'file_1'}` | 0 rows | count 1 | count 0 | count 1 |
| `pic {$contains: 'file'}` | 0 rows | count 2 | count 0 | count 2 |
| `pic {$contains: '"file_1"'}` | 0 rows | count 1 | count 0 | count 0 |

## Why

- Native face: `whereContainsMembershipSql` (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/contains-membership-sql.ts`) asks only the declared shape, so a single-value media column falls to a text match over the stored JSON text.
- Preview: `matchesWhere` in `preview-evaluator.ts` text-matches the bare drafted id.
- Data door and ObjectQL face: driver-sql's JSON membership finds no member in a single JSON string.

Seam: `spec:FILTER_OPERATORS.$contains` → `NativeSQLStrategy.buildFilterClause` / `whereContainsMembershipSql` | `preview-evaluator matchesWhere`. Found in the #36190 dev's rework report (comment 7122766475 on #36190); #36771 deliberately leaves `$contains` out of its refusal set.

## Done when

One answer for `$contains` on a single-value media column across the four faces (which answer — refusal, text match or membership — is the card's first ruling; follow the data door's precedent unless a ruling says otherwise), pinned on the #36190 fixture.
